description: Monday is an autonomous AI assistant that runs locally on macOS. The agent loop is the central orchestration layer - it chains perception (audio capture), cognition (LLM reasoning), and action (speech synthesis) into a continuous conversation flow that does not require re-triggering the wake word between turns.

text: Most voice assistants require you to say the wake word before every single interaction. I found this unnatural - real conversations have follow-ups. So Monday listens for a configurable timeout after each response, and if you speak again within that window, it processes the follow-up as part of the same conversation context.

codeSnippet.name: agent_loop.py - _process_and_respond()

text: Each turn within the conversation has an intelligent branching decision: when tools are registered (calendar, system controls, etc.), it uses a non-streaming tool-use path that can execute actions. When no tools are available, it streams directly to TTS for lower latency. The system adapts its behavior based on what capabilities are loaded.

codeSnippet.name: agent_loop.py - _respond_once()

list: Conversation continuity without wake word re-triggering - feels natural
State indicator tracks the current phase (listening, thinking, speaking, idle) for the overlay UI
Memory accumulates across turns so context is preserved within a conversation
The collector pattern in the streaming path captures the full response for memory while simultaneously piping chunks to TTS
Configurable timeout and max turns prevent runaway conversations
